segmente.text: If you are trying to sell to everyone, you will sell to no one.
The thing is, your product can never be good for everyone.
Samsung fans will never own an Apple product.
Pepsi fans will never choose Coca-Cola over it.
Focus on one group of people and make it your target audience.
Because people listen when they feel seen.
This is why your marketing should feel like a mirror.
They should feel like you understand them better than they understand themselves.
This will build trust and increase your sales.
